_ordering_rationale: Broadcom = 2 segments (Semiconductor Solutions + Infrastructure Software post-VMware). KPIs ordres: Semi Solutions revenue (XPU/AI heart), Infrastructure SW (VMware platform), OCF (cash king Broadcom), Products vs Subscriptions split.

kpis.signal: Coeur AVGO: XPU custom AI (hyperscalers Google, Meta) + Ethernet networking. Acceleration FY25 +22% portee par AI compute
kpis.description_fr: CA Semi Solutions: XPU AI custom, Ethernet switching, RF wireless, broadband. ~58% du CA FY25, hypercroissance via AI accelerators et networking AI data centers.
kpis.description_en: Semi Solutions revenue: custom AI XPU, Ethernet switching, RF wireless, broadband. ~58% of FY25 revenue, hypergrowth from AI accelerators and AI data center networking.

kpis.signal: Saut FY24 = integration VMware (acquisition cloturee 22-11-2023). Forte conversion modele subscription VCF, +26% FY25
kpis.description_fr: CA Infrastructure Software = VMware (VCF) + Symantec + CA Technologies. Modele subscription, marges elevees. Transformation strategique post-acquisition VMware $69 Mds.
kpis.description_en: Infra Software revenue = VMware (VCF) + Symantec + CA Technologies. Subscription model, high margins. Strategic transformation post-$69B VMware acquisition.

kpis.signal: Machine cash: doublement sur 5 ans ($13.8 -> $27.5 Mds). Soutient dividende, buyback et deleveraging post-VMware
kpis.description_fr: Cash flow operationnel annuel. KPI signature Broadcom: marges Semi >55% + Software subscription = cash machine. Permet remboursement dette VMware en accelere.
kpis.description_en: Annual operating cash flow. Signature Broadcom KPI: Semi 55%+ margins + Software subscription = cash machine. Funds accelerated VMware debt paydown.

kpis.signal: Bond FY24 (VMware) puis +15%. Vise CA recurrent SaaS-like, plus value re-rating multiple
kpis.description_fr: Subscriptions & services (vs Products). Mesure conversion vers modele recurrent. Avec VMware en mode subscription, devient ~30% du CA total et re-evalue le multiple.
kpis.description_en: Subscriptions & services (vs Products). Tracks shift to recurring model. With VMware subscription transition, ~30% of revenue and key for multiple re-rating.
